# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first portrait canvas arcade shooter titled **Spartan Shieldfall Arena**. Preserve the mechanics of a touch-follow vertical arena shooter: start button, player follows pointer/touch with a slight above-finger offset, auto-fire while input is held, falling tiered hazards split when shot, scoring follows tier destruction, collision causes game over, and restart resets the run.

Theme the game as: Halo sci-fi arena shooter with super-soldier combat, alien war, vehicle battles, heroic scale, clean military futurism, shield-based firefights, epic orchestral grandeur, and mobile-first portrait controls.

The player should read as a shielded super-soldier in clean futuristic armor. Hazards should read as alien drop vehicles and plasma fragments. The HUD should use clear military sci-fi language: Covenant Breaks, Fireteam Orders, Shield Line Breached, Deploy Spartan, Redeploy. The background should be procedural and authored: orbital fleet silhouettes, shield rings, blue/cyan grid lanes, heroic scale, and restrained mobile-readable effects. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS, Orbitron/Rajdhani fonts, and safe user-gesture audio.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a portrait-friendly canvas arcade shooter. The player starts a run, drags/touches the canvas to make the avatar smoothly follow a target offset above the finger, and auto-fires while contact is active. Falling tier-3 hazards spawn from the top, move downward, split into smaller tier hazards when shot, award score by tier, and end the run on player collision. There is no win state; survival and score pursuit are the progression.

## Protected Mechanics
- Start screen, active play, game-over, and restart state flow.
- Pointer/touch/mouse target-follow input with thumb offset.
- Auto-fire only while input is active.
- Delta-time update loop, falling hazards, bullet travel, hazard splitting, score formula, and collision game-over.
- Mobile portrait actionability and clear HUD/restart path.

## Remixed Target
Halo sci-fi arena shooter with super-soldier combat, alien war, vehicle battles, heroic scale, clean military futurism, shield-based firefights, epic orchestral grandeur, and mobile-first portrait controls. The same shooter loop is reframed as a shielded super-soldier holding an orbital arena line against alien vehicles and plasma fragments.

## Canonical Surface
The new public `index.html` is a self-contained browser-native Canvas/DOM implementation. `index_old.html` is reference-only.
